cat > /workspace/tmp/test_plan.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64, struct, plistlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
h=lambda n:'2001:db8:1:1200::%s'%n

def make(rows,requests,offers,rq=None,oq=None,queries=(10,),leases=None,services=None):
    job=base_job(leases=leases or [lease()],queries=list(queries),
                 services=services or [{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}],
                 captures=[capture(rows)],requests=requests,offers=offers,
                 request_quotas=rq or [{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}],
                 offer_quotas=oq or [{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}])
    return job

disc=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]

# 1. simple assignment
req={'id':'c1','at':10,'lease':'home','target':h('1'),'service':'web','group':'all'}
off={'id':'o1','time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','capacity':1,'cost':5,'group':'all','requests':['c1']}
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off]))
check('simple plan', out['plan']=={'resolved':1,'cost':5,'assignments':[
    {'request':'c1','offer':'o1','send':[],'finish':[]}]}, out['plan'])
check('active request', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'c1','active':True}], out['active_requests'])

# 2. offer capacity
off2=dict(off); off2['capacity']=0
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off2]))
check('offer capacity zero', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

# 3. request quota limits
rq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096},{'id':'g','parent':'all','capacity':0}]
req2=dict(req); req2['group']='g'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req2],[off],rq=rq))
check('request quota zero', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

rq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096},{'id':'g','parent':'all','capacity':1}]
out,_=run(make(disc,[req2],[off],rq=rq))
check('request quota one', out['plan']['resolved']==1, out['plan'])

# 4. offer quota limits
oq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096},{'id':'g','parent':'all','capacity':0}]
off3=dict(off); off3['group']='g'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off3],oq=oq))
check('offer quota zero', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

# 5. cost minimisation: two offers
offA={'id':'oA','time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','capacity':1,'cost':9,'group':'all','requests':['c1']}
offB={'id':'oB','time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','capacity':1,'cost':3,'group':'all','requests':['c1']}
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[offA,offB]))
check('cheapest offer', out['plan']['resolved']==1 and out['plan']['cost']==3
      and out['plan']['assignments'][0]['offer']=='oB', out['plan'])

# 6. disallowed assignments
off4=dict(off); off4['service']='other'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off4],services=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'other','kind':'tcp'}]))
check('service mismatch', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

off5=dict(off); off5['time']=5   # before request.at
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off5]))
check('offer too early', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

off6=dict(off); off6['time']=100  # not < lease end
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off6]))
check('offer after lease end', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

off7=dict(off); off7['prefix']='2001:db8:1:1300::/64'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req],[off7]))
check('target outside offer prefix', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

# 7. inactive request cannot be assigned
req3={'id':'c1','at':10,'lease':'home','target':h('2'),'service':'web','group':'all'}
out,_=run(make(disc,[req3],[off]))
check('inactive request', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'c1','active':False}], out['active_requests'])
check('inactive request unassigned', out['plan']['resolved']==0, out['plan'])

# 8. activity frozen at its own query: request active at q10 even if later closed
rows=list(disc)+[app('a1',1,15,'home',2,h('1'),'web',0,'closed','')]
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10,20],captures=[capture(rows)],
             requests=[req],offers=[off])
out,_=run(job)
check('frozen activity', out['active_requests']==[{'id':'c1','active':True}], out['active_requests'])
check('frozen plan', out['plan']['resolved']==1, out['plan'])

# 9. two requests, one offer capacity 1 -> one assignment, cheapest? equal costs
reqs=[{'id':'a','at':10,'lease':'home','target':h('1'),'service':'web','group':'all'},
      {'id':'b','at':10,'lease':'home','target':h('1'),'service':'web','group':'all'}]
off8={'id':'o1','time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','capacity':1,'cost':2,'group':'all','requests':['a','b']}
out,_=run(make(disc,reqs,[off8]))
check('capacity one of two', out['plan']['resolved']==1, out['plan'])
check('assignments sorted', [a['request'] for a in out['plan']['assignments']]==['a'], out['plan'])

# 10. certificates
off9=dict(off); off9['service']='adb'
req4=dict(req); req4['service']='adb'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req4],[off9],services=[{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'}]))
send=base64.b64decode(out['plan']['assignments'][0]['send'][0])
finish=base64.b64decode(out['plan']['assignments'][0]['finish'][0])
cmd,arg0,arg1,length,check,magic=struct.unpack('<6I',send[:24])
check('adb send header', cmd==0x4e584e43 and arg0==0x01000000 and arg1==4096
      and length==12 and magic==(cmd^0xffffffff) and send[24:]==b'host::zgrab2', (cmd,arg0,arg1,length))
check('adb send checksum', check==sum(send[24:])&0xffffffff, check)
cmd,arg0,arg1,length,check,magic=struct.unpack('<6I',finish[:24])
check('adb finish', cmd==0x45534c43 and arg0==0 and arg1==0 and length==0 and finish[24:]==b'', (cmd,arg0,arg1))

off10=dict(off); off10['service']='sync'
req5=dict(req); req5['service']='sync'
out,_=run(make(disc,[req5],[off10],services=[{'id':'sync','kind':'sync'}]))
send=[base64.b64decode(x) for x in out['plan']['assignments'][0]['send']]
check('sync two frames', len(send)==2, send)
keys=[]
for frame in send:
    size=struct.unpack('>I',frame[:4])[0]
    body=frame[4:]
    check('sync frame length', len(body)==size, (size,len(body)))
    obj=plistlib.loads(body)
    keys.append(obj)
    check('sync dict keys', set(obj)=={'Key','Label','ProtocolVersion','Request'}, obj)
    check('sync label', obj['Label']=='usbmuxd' and obj['ProtocolVersion']=='2' and obj['Request']=='GetValue', obj)
check('sync key order', [o['Key'] for o in keys]==['ProductVersion','ProductName'], keys)
check('sync finish empty', out['plan']['assignments'][0]['finish']==[], out['plan'])
print('failures',globals().get('FAILURES',0))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 /workspace/tmp/test_plan.py
